user.description: Enter the IP address of your Astrion device (the local config server on port 8080 must be reachable).
user.title: Set up Astrion Custom Dashboard

set_page.description: Jumps the Astrion remote's dashboard to the given page.

page.description: Name of the page to display, as configured in dashboard.json (case-insensitive).
page.name: Page

set_page.name: Set page

start_activity.description: Starts a Astrion Activity by id, in whichever room it belongs to.

activity_id.description: Id of the activity to start, as returned by the astrion device's /activities endpoint.
activity_id.name: Activity ID

start_activity.name: Start activity

stop_activity.description: Stops whichever Activity is currently active in a room, without starting another. For a Harmony-backed Activity this sends PowerOff to that Activity's own hub only.

room.description: Name of the room to stop, as configured in dashboard.json.
room.name: Room

stop_activity.name: Stop activity
